_comment: Real charts bundled for debugging without the sim. Personal use only — UK AIP charts are (c) NATS / Crown copyright; do not redistribute. Georeference either as 'grid' (straight lat/lon grid: lines measured in PDF points, y up) or 'lambert' (fitted Lambert conic: chart = t + s·R(θ)·[u, −v] in display coordinates after 'rotate'). 'rotate' = 90 turns a sideways page clockwise so north is up. 'frame' is the map area in display chart units from the top-left. Each entry was checked against coordinates printed on the chart (waypoints/navaids land on their symbols).
